intro.text: A Torish yoki-hijo who became Yumi's friend when they were both girls in training.

items.text: Samjae and Yumi became friends as girls, while both were still training as yoki-hijo.

Against Liyun's rules, Samjae secretly told Yumi stories of yoki-hijo who fell in love and ran away, until Liyun separated them, believing the friendship was bad for Yumi. After the father machine was switched on, Samjae was held captive with the other thirteen yoki-hijo without knowing it.
